notes: DaVinci Resolve connects more reliably on machines with a custom Python setup: stray PYTHONHOME/PYTHONPATH variables (common with Anaconda or a developer Python) could point Resolve's scripting library at the wrong interpreter and block the connection on launch — Cut Valet now clears those for its own connection. And when a connection still fails, one Send Diagnostics report now names the cause: whether Resolve's library loads at all on your machine, your Visual C++ runtime version, and any stray Python environment — no more back-and-forth.
